step_by_step_approach: Remove any non-numeric characters from the salary values and convert them to numbers.
Limit the data to records from Mumbai, Pune, New Delhi, and Hyderabad.
Calculate the average salary for each company within each of those cities.
Calculate the overall average salary across all records in the dataset.
Identify the five companies with the highest average salary in each city.
For each of those companies, associate its city average salary with the overall national average salary.
Present the results with columns: Location, Company Name, Average Salary in State, and Average Salary in Country.
